description: This file defines a base interface 'Event' for all event types emitted by the Ditto framework, including methods for retrieving event properties and nested class for JSON field definitions.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: A base interface for all event types emitted by Ditto, providing methods for event properties and JSON serialization.

classes.name: Event.JsonFields
classes.description: A nested class containing definitions of JSON fields used in event serialization.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of this event.

methods.name: getImplementedSchemaVersion
methods.description: Returns the schema version implemented by this event, defaulting to the latest if not specified.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Returns the revision number of the event.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new copy of the event with the specified revision.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the event, if available.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns the metadata associated with the event, if available.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the event to a JSON object including only non-hidden fields.
